Migrated the last 12 stragglers to `db.execute({ sql, params })` — one call each in `analytics/cohort`, `orders/returnService`, `orders/shipment`, `billing/refund`, `billing/couponService`, `support/macroAdmin`, `support/sla`, `catalog/variantAdmin`, `catalog/supplier`, `accounts/teamService`, `accounts/apiKeyAdmin`, and `accounts/session`.

Left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` alone since it's vendored and gets overwritten on upgrade, and left `cache.query` calls untouched since that's a different thing entirely.

`node verify.js` passes clean.
